$summary: The wash that dims the page behind a modal surface.

theme.scrim.summary: A translucent wash over everything behind a modal, so the surface in front reads as the only thing you can act on.
use: Any full-screen wash whose job is to make the layer above it the only interactive one.
dont: As a background for content. It is translucent, so whatever is behind shows through and no contrast promise about text on it can hold.
For a non-modal overlay. A menu or popover does not dim the page, because the page is still live behind it — dimming implies the rest is inert, and for a menu it is not.
As a hover or press wash. That is the state layer, which tints a control rather than covering the page.
